answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be continually earned through sustained honest service; inactivity steadily erodes trust. EigenTrust’s reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagates confidence only through credible links, while freshly spawned Sybil identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and lack trusted paths, so they cannot pass consensus. A plume of collusion cannot redraw the atlas of trust or forge durable standing.
